description: A well-formed approval signed by a trusted key, claiming the authority that key is trusted for, verifies.

description: Changing any signed field (here the approver id) breaks the signature.
An approval with no issuedAt is malformed.
A signature that is not 64 bytes of hex does not verify.
With trusted keys declared, an approval wait returns an approval request carrying the request digest and the rulebook fingerprint to sign.
A verified signed approval bound to this request and this rulebook clears the wait.
The same signed approval without `verified: true` (the caller never verified it) does not clear the wait.
With trusted keys declared, a plain { id, authority } approval no longer clears anything.
A verified approval for a different request (digest mismatch) does not clear this one.
A verified approval given under another rulebook (fingerprint mismatch) does not clear the wait.
A verified approval still has to hold what the rule names: a lead's approval does not clear a wait by "high".
A verified approval by role tag clears a wait that names that tag.
Back-compat, development only: with no trusted keys declared, a plain { id, authority } approval clears the wait.
